title: Battery Capacity Estimator (Kalman Filter)
text: 使用卡尔曼滤波器的电池容量估计器，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Specify Current input as cell current(s)} 指定将电流输入端口指定为向量、{Filter type} 指定卡尔曼滤波器类型 Extended Kalman、{Alpha}、{Beta}、{Kappa}、{Covariance of the process noise, Q} 指定过程噪声的协方差 3e-4、{Covariance of the measurement noise, R} 指定测量噪声的协方差 5e-7、{Initial state error covariance, P0} 指定初始状态误差协方差 1e-8、{Algorithm data type} 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit，按实例取值。

ports.name: Current
ports.summary: 电池电流，安培 scalar | vector

ports.name: CellSOC
ports.summary: 电芯荷电状态，无量纲 scalar | vector

ports.name: InitialCellAH
ports.summary: 初始电芯容量，A*Hr scalar | vector

ports.name: CellAH
ports.summary: 估计的电芯容量 scalar | vector

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: 将电流输入端口指定为向量的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Filter type
params.values: 卡尔曼滤波器类型 Extended Kalman filter (default) | Extended Kalman-Bucy filter | Unscented Kalman filter | Unscented Kalman-Bucy filter

params.name: Alpha
params.values: Alpha 系数 1 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 1]

params.name: Kappa
params.values: Kappa 系数 0 (default) | scalar in the range [0, 3]

params.name: Covariance of the process noise, Q
params.values: 过程噪声的协方差 3e-4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Covariance of the measurement noise, R
params.values: 测量噪声的协方差 5e-7 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial state error covariance, P0
params.values: 初始状态误差协方差 1e-8 (default) | scalar | matrix

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: 用于选择模块算法数据类型的选项 Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
